statements.markdown:
**Approximating a specified finite observable.** First fix $T,N$ and the
positive finite normalizers in §7. The rooted construction in §8.1 has
energy exactly $S_{T,N}$. Let $z$ be a smoothed version of its rounded
spin $F_N$, let $m=\sin(2\theta)$ be the bounded formula's spin output,
and let $m^{\mathrm{col}}$ be its color-excluded approximation. Write
$$
\delta_s=\|z-F_N\|_2,\qquad
\delta_b=\|m-z\|_2,\qquad
\delta_c=\|m^{\mathrm{col}}-m\|_2.
$$
These measure errors of the spin outputs, not of the angles. The rooted
shift is a contraction, so
$$
|\mathcal E(f)-\mathcal E(g)|
\le(\|f\|_2+\|g\|_2)\|f-g\|_2.
$$
All these outputs have norm at most one. Apply synthesis with tolerance
$\eta_s$ and total helper probability $p_H$, then remove the seeds with
energy tolerance $\eta_r$. The source's absolute synthesis bound and
seed-removal theorem, followed by fixed-word transfer, give one ordinary
word $W$ with
$$
|v(W)-S_{T,N}|
\le2(\delta_s+\delta_b+\delta_c)
       +2\eta_s+2\sqrt{p_H}+\eta_r.
\tag{8.2}
$$
statements.section: 8.6 Fixing the word before the thermodynamic limit

statements.markdown:
This establishes an absolute approximation of each specified finite
$S_{T,N}$ in the construction, without assuming it is already near $P_*$.
It preserves the energy; it does not assert reproduction of the entire
classical output law.
statements.section: 8.6 Fixing the word before the thermodynamic limit

statements.markdown:
**Proposition 5 (circuit approximation; a consequence of
[OpenAI (2026b), §§2–5][Q]).** For each fixed $T,N$ in the preceding
construction with finite positive normalisers, and every $\eta>0$,
there is a finite ordinary QAOA word $W$, with deterministic angles
independent of $n$ and $J$, such that
$$
|v(W)-S_{T,N}|<\eta.
$$
statements.section: 5.3 A fixed QAOA circuit before the thermodynamic limit

statements.markdown:
**Construction underlying Proposition 5.**
[OpenAI (2026b), §§3–5][Q] smooths the spin and approximates every
transmitted function by a bounded smooth map, preserving oddness; smoothing
the final sign alone is insufficient. Its class exclusions prevent return
through a traversed branch and reserve helper classes on which the output is
zero, with positive probabilities fixed during synthesis. The resulting finite
formula is approximated in energy using
temporary Gaussian controls, with the same sitewise seeds throughout the word.
Removing those controls produces an ordinary word, whose limiting energy is
$v(W)$ by the fixed-word transfer. The approximation errors are absolute and
can be chosen successively for each fixed $S_{T,N}$, before it is chosen close
to $P_*$. The preserved quantity is energy; the measured-configuration
conclusion below uses a further concentration theorem.
statements.section: 5.3 A fixed QAOA circuit before the thermodynamic limit
